description: Inspect indexed API routes, inferred response-shape keys, client consumers, middleware, and route-level process facts before changing a handler or contract.

file.description: Optional route or handler file path inside the indexed project.

limit.description: Max routes and process rows to surface (default: 10, capped at 25)

name.description: Optional handler symbol name, paired with symbol_file

route.description: Optional route path or method+path filter, for example `/api/users` or `GET /api/users`.

symbol_file.description: File path used with name to disambiguate the handler symbol

verbosity.description: Response budget. `minimal` returns the shortest actionable answer, `compact` keeps key reasoning visible, and `full` includes supporting detail.

name: api_impact
title: API Impact
